en-US.description: Encrypt, upload, and decrypt files with Bytifi from the terminal
en-US.longDescription: Official Bytifi command-line tool. Gzip-compresses and encrypts files locally, uploads encrypted bytes to bytifi.com with multipart support for large files, and decrypts shared files from the terminal.
